targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "BRGB")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.pi_id == "${pi_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.simulated =~ /${simulated:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["r","g","b"]))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r.r == 1.0 and r.g == 0.0 and r.b == 0.0 then "RED"
    else if r.r == 0.0 and r.g == 1.0 and r.b == 0.0 then "GREEN"
    else if r.r == 0.0 and r.g == 0.0 and r.b == 1.0 then "BLUE"
    else if r.r == 1.0 and r.g == 1.0 and r.b == 1.0 then "WHITE"
    else if r.r == 0.0 and r.g == 0.0 and r.b == 0.0 then "OFF"
    else "CUSTOM" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","_value"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "BRGB")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.pi_id == "${pi_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.simulated =~ /${simulated:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["r","g","b"]))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "LCD")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.pi_id == "${pi_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.simulated =~ /${simulated:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["line1","line2"]))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","line1","line2"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "IR")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.pi_id == "${pi_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.simulated =~ /${simulated:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","_value","pi_id","simulated"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 25)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "DPIR3")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.pi_id == "${pi_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.simulated =~ /${simulated:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value then "MOTION" else "CLEAR" }))

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
